scope: Twelve explicitly selected, ended public-development pilots; no later active evaluation outputs are included.
measurement_policy: Known totals require a final artifact and complete recorded provider usage. Incomplete attempts show only observed subtotals and keep total tokens/cost null. Missing values are never replaced by zero; provider reservations are not billed cost. All failed, interrupted, awaiting-approval and unstarted outcomes are retained. Historic comparable flags are recorded but not trusted as completeness gates.
success_policy: Completed external grading must pass, daemon status must be completed, and the budget flag must explicitly be false. Unknown historical budget flags prevent certified success.
privacy_policy: Allowlisted aggregate fields only: no user paths, credential values, request bodies, response streams, internal generation identifiers, private reasoning, or profile databases.

old_zai01_descriptive.accounting: Per attempt: run input+output tokens plus (common training coding tokens + learned-only reflection tokens)/12. Count every failed attempt in token totals; divide aggregate lifecycle totals by successful attempts. Raw/off have zero additional model preparation. No unknown usage is imputed. H=12 is amortization, not 12 observed tasks.

causal_limit: Offline tests establish boundedness, provenance, redaction and harness-isolation behavior. They do not establish learning quality, token savings or benchmark advantage. No result from the subsequent evaluation is used, and no formal significance analysis is applied to these exploratory pilots.
